projects.title: Web Archive Tool (WAT)
projects.description: WAT is a web archiving tool that allows users to download large sets of URLs and extract the main content of each url. This tool is intended to help NLP researchers build large datasets in order to understand the narrative in different foreign articles and identify disinformation (fake news).

projects.title: Image Segmentation
projects.description: This Python script uses OpenCV to segment objects in an image given a region of interest. This can be used for annotating images in a dataset.
